issue.body:
I tried to implement a middleware that would append a namespace to all routes, but received error that "Attribute can't be set".
```
PREFIX = 'v1/'


class URLPrefixMiddleware(base_mw.BaseHTTPMiddleware):
    async def dispatch(self, request, call_next):
        print(request.base_url)
        request.url = f'{request.url}{PREFIX}'
        response = await call_next(request)
        return response


middleware = [
    Middleware(URLPrefixMiddleware),
]
```
Tried with request.base_url as well.

How could I implement this?

issue.title: How can I add a url prefix to all routes?
